_comment: Ground truth for the DMG test corpus. Generated by tools/make-manifest.sh - do not hand-edit. Every decoded_sha256 comes from Apple's own decoder (hdiutil), never from our reader; a hash produced by the code under test would make the test circular.
_staleness: hdiutil bakes volume UUIDs and timestamps into the images, so re-running tools/make-fixtures.sh yields a corpus with different hashes. This manifest describes the corpus currently in fixtures/generated/, not a universal golden value. Regenerate it whenever you regenerate the fixtures; compare image_sha256 to detect drift.

hash.subject: the fully decoded raw sector stream - the whole-disk image with every codec and the encryption wrapper removed, exactly as Apple's decoder produces it
hash.method_encrypted: printf '%s\n' | hdiutil attach -stdinpass -nomount -readonly , then dd if=/dev/rdiskN bs=1m | shasum -a 256, then detach that exact device

cross_check.note: Both methods produced the same SHA-256 for exfat-zlib.dmg, so 'convert to .cdr' and 'attach and read /dev/rdiskN' are the same byte stream.

shared_source_note: exfat-raw, exfat-zlib, exfat-udro, exfat-enc256, exfat-enc128, exfat-enc-udzo, bzip2 and adc are all converted from one shared 12 MiB exFAT source image, so their decoded_sha256 values must be identical. That equality is itself a test: it isolates the codec and the encryption wrapper from everything else.

fixtures.name: exfat-raw.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDRW
fixtures.purpose: Flat sector image - UDRW has no koly trailer and no chunk table, so despite the name it carries no chunks of any type. The reader must find no container in it.

fixtures.name: exfat-zlib.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDZO

fixtures.name: exfat-udro.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDRO
fixtures.purpose: Genuine raw (0x00000001) UDIF chunks - a real koly + plist + blkx container storing its chunks uncompressed.

fixtures.name: exfat-sparse.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 48m -fs exFAT -volname DMGSPARSE, one small file | hdiutil convert -format UDZO
fixtures.purpose: Mostly empty volume, so most chunks are zero-fill / ignore.

fixtures.name: exfat-enc256.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDRW -encryption AES-256 -stdinpass

fixtures.name: exfat-enc128.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDRW -encryption AES-128 -stdinpass
fixtures.purpose: encrcdsa v2 wrapper, AES-128 key length.

fixtures.name: exfat-enc-udzo.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDZO -encryption AES-256 -stdinpass
fixtures.purpose: encrcdsa v2 wrapper around a genuine UDZO UDIF container (S4.10/#91) - the decrypted payload carries a koly trailer, property list and zlib chunk table, unlike exfat-enc256/128 which wrap a flat UDRW stream with no koly at all.

fixtures.name: fat32.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 48m -fs 'MS-DOS FAT32' -volname DMGFAT32 | hdiutil convert -format UDZO
fixtures.purpose: FAT32 probe. 48 MiB because FAT32 needs at least 65525 clusters.

fixtures.name: hfsplus.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs 'HFS+' -volname DMGHFS | hdiutil convert -format UDZO
fixtures.purpose: Negative case - the reader must refuse HFS+.

fixtures.name: apfs.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 32m -fs APFS -volname DMGAPFS | hdiutil convert -format UDZO
fixtures.purpose: Negative case - the reader must refuse APFS. 32 MiB because APFS will not newfs into 12 MiB.

fixtures.name: bzip2.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDBZ
fixtures.purpose: Negative case - bzip2 is an unsupported codec.

fixtures.name: adc.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 12m -fs exFAT -volname DMGFIX | hdiutil convert -format UDCO

fixtures.name: multipart.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -size 80m -layout NONE -type UDIF | diskutil partitionDisk MBR ExFAT DMGFIXP1 36M ExFAT DMGFIXP2 R | hdiutil convert -format UDZO
fixtures.purpose: Two data partitions, for partition selection. MBR not GPT - diskutil insists on a 200 MiB EFI partition under GPT.

fixtures.name: zerofill.dmg
fixtures.recipe: hdiutil create -srcfolder <HELLO.TXT README.TXT DATA.BIN ZEROS.BIN> -fs exFAT -volname DMGZERO -format UDZO
fixtures.purpose: Zero-fill (0x00000000) chunks alongside zlib and ignore. 'create -srcfolder' is the only hdiutil path found that emits zero-fill; every 'convert' recipe uses the codec for zeros and 'ignore' for free space. ZEROS.BIN puts a long zero run inside allocated space.
